title: Minecraft Bone Meal Farm Tutorial V2 - Self Sustaining - 5300 P/H!
description:
In this Tutorial, I Will Show you how to make a Super Efficient [V2] and simple Bone Meal Farm Based On Moss Blocks that is self-sustaining! In Minecraft
❌IMPORTANT: At 10:40 be sure to put water on those stairs this is the most common problem 

📚This Bonemeal Farm is so fast and can produce +4800 -~ 5300 Bonemeals Per Hour!
📚This bonemeal farm is self-sustaining!
📚It's so easy to build you can build this farm only in 20 - 30 minutes!
📚Unfortunately because of some game mechanics, this farm doesn't work on the bedrock edition

I Hope to Enjoy My Video !!🙏🥰
